source: The people hung almost everything from me. They were obsessed with using my branches, like the nesting birds. On warm summer weekends, piñatas swayed from my boughs over squealing birthday children made wild by sweets. Witches and bats and cottony cobwebs covered my branches around the Halloween time. All of it left behind and forgotten until the people realized that their winter holidays will soon begin. (Those wretched cobwebs are never completely removed.) And so came the novelty-sized ornaments, candy canes, and strings upon strings of twinkling yellow lights, at the expense of some of my smaller boughs. By springtime, my branches are invaded by multicolored plastic eggs and clumsy bird feeders made by the Asbury Seniors Handicrafts Club. As cyclical as the seasons, the people continued these rituals year over year. But recently, I found that they are not like the robins, starlings, blue jays, and crows. Death changes the people entirely. I see that the nesting birds return and see me as the ideal nesting tree. Close to worms and grubs, and also to bread crumbs and trash. Every year, many birdlings tumble to their deaths or fall prey to owls and hawks. The young die in droves. Yet, even after many deaths, the birds return each year, obsessed all the same with nesting. On schedule and unwavering. The people saw me as perfect for hanging many things. Which, to their own horror, included a person. A single death. One death and the people break their decades-long obsession of decorating me. They shun my branches. They reject a joyful pattern in their lives. Why? For fear of death? For sadness? For disgust? If the nesting birds were this way, I would hold no life at all.
target: 人們幾乎什麼都往我身上掛。他們迷戀使用我的枝椏，就像那些築巢的鳥。 溫暖的夏日週末，裝滿糖果的彩罐從我枝頭搖晃。底下過生日的孩子們，被甜食逗得又叫又跳。 萬聖節前後，女巫、蝙蝠、棉絮般的蜘蛛網覆滿枝椏。這些東西被留下、被遺忘，直到人們想起冬日節慶就要到來。（那些可恨的蜘蛛網，從來沒有清乾淨過。） 於是，特大號的裝飾球、拐杖糖，還有一串接一串閃爍的黃燈登場，代價是折損我幾根細枝。 到了春天，我的枝椏又遭到五彩塑膠蛋，以及阿斯伯里長者手工藝社那些笨拙鳥食台的入侵。 人們年復一年重複這些儀式，如四季般循環。但最近我發現，他們和知更鳥、椋鳥、冠藍鴉、烏鴉並不一樣。死亡會徹底改變人。 築巢的鳥年年回來，將我視為理想的築巢之樹。這裡靠近蚯蚓與幼蟲，也靠近麵包屑和垃圾。 每一年，都有許多雛鳥墜地身亡，或成為貓頭鷹與鷹的獵物。幼小的生命成批死去。然而，即使經歷那麼多死亡，鳥兒仍年年回來，一樣執著於築巢。按時到來，毫不動搖。 人們覺得我很適合懸掛各種東西。然而，讓他們驚駭的是，這也包括一個人。一條人命。 只是一條人命，人們就放棄了數十年來裝飾我的執念。他們避開我的枝椏，拒絕了生活中那個快樂的循環。為什麼？害怕死亡？悲傷？厭惡？ 如果築巢的鳥也如此，我身上就不會有任何生命了。

source: How quiet here in the deep of Pine Hills Park. This abandoned child’s grave, this little plot for a “Sadie Sloan” – my own Gethsemane. The place of the vision. Quiet as a prayer, save for the Lord’s chirping creations and my seething mood. Fuck. Fuck! I cannot seem to shake the anger. Should I have done more for Isaiah? My dear Isaiah – I’ll never forget the tender warmth of our time… There is certainly something I could've done or said to assuage his pain and awful drug delusions! What sort of shepherd am I that protects his congregation and not the whole of the Lord’s flock? After all, was he not the one who affirmed my love for the Lord? How do I stand idly by before such an opportunity to provide redemption? Sister Brenda says I have to be kinder on my soul, to see his horrible death as part of the Lord’s mystery. If anything, I’m eager to save poor Romina from Isaiah’s fate. I know she loved him… as I did…
target: 松丘公園深處，多麼寂靜。這座被遺棄的孩童墳墓，這塊屬於「莎蒂・斯隆」的小小墓地——我自己的革責瑪尼。異象降臨之處。這裡靜得像一場禱告，除了主所造生靈的鳴叫，以及我心中沸騰的情緒。 幹。幹！ 我似乎始終無法擺脫憤怒。我是不是該為以賽亞多做些什麼？親愛的以賽亞——我永遠不會忘記，我們相處時那份溫柔的暖意…… 我一定能做些什麼、說些什麼，減輕他的痛苦，平息毒品帶來的可怕妄想！我究竟是什麼樣的牧者，只保護自己的教眾，卻不保護主全部的羊群？畢竟，不正是他，堅定了我對主的愛嗎？面對這樣一個給予救贖的機會，我怎能袖手旁觀？ 布蘭達修女說，我得對自己的靈魂仁慈一些，把他可怕的死，視為主奧祕的一部分。無論如何，我迫切希望能救下可憐的蘿蜜娜，不讓她重蹈以賽亞的命運。我知道她愛他……就像我一樣……

source: My love, oh my love, my lovely light. The police lights at dawn made me see it, see you, you hanging from Grand Rosa and I died again in my body. I died first in your arms in the field, and awakened. Then you left me long ago, after your fields burned, and I died again. Now you come back to kill me all over, but why... but... Try try try to remember. Okay, yeah. Eyes closed and go digging deep, dig up the memory. The dark, the bits, the little girl … Oh can you hear me? I miss the sound of your words Pathfinder. NEVER have I doubted the vision of your third eye, I still got my mission. Yes, yes, it's always been to keep the gateway open with the one-eyed angel. Mhmm, I feel it in my skin, I know what you MEAN now. It’s the woman in town, the eye-patch woman, the one-eyed angel. All of it makes sense. It’s like… I lose more to see more. The rip, the green gem necklace, and the one-eyed angel . I gotta think some. I must show the one-eyed angel. It’ll be worth it though when it happens. The tears won't stop. You die by me. You die and I die for the third time. You die and I rise. I rise inside because I remember now what MATTERS. I cry because of the sadness of dying and happiness of remembering. Obviously, so obvious -- the green gem necklace and the gate and the one-eyed angel -- it comes together as the path. I remember my path as clear as rain! The dark, the bits, the little girl, the rip, the green gem necklace, and the one-eyed angel.
target: 我的愛，哦，我的愛，我美麗的光。黎明的警燈讓我看見了，看見你，你吊在大羅莎的枝頭，我又一次死在自己的身體裡。第一次是在田野裡、在你懷中死去，然後甦醒。後來，好久以前，你的田地燒毀，你離開我，我又死了一次。現在你回來，再把我殺一遍，可是為什麼……可是…… 想起來，想起來，努力想起來。好，對。閉上眼睛往深處挖，把記憶挖出來。黑暗，碎片，小女孩……哦，你聽得見我嗎？尋路者，我想念你說話的聲音。我從來沒有懷疑過你第三隻眼睛看見的異象，我還記得自己的使命。對，對，一直都是要靠獨眼天使，讓通道保持開啟。 嗯嗯，我的皮膚感覺得到，現在我懂你的意思了。就是鎮上的那個女人，戴眼罩的女人，獨眼天使。一切都說得通。就像……我失去越多，就看見越多。裂縫，綠寶石項鍊，還有獨眼天使。我得想想。我一定得讓獨眼天使看見。等事情成了，一切都值得。 眼淚停不下來。你在我身旁死去。你死了，我也第三次死去。你死了，我卻站起來。我在心裡站起來，因為我終於想起，什麼才重要。我哭，因為死去的悲傷，也因為想起來的喜悅。很明顯，明顯得不得了——綠寶石項鍊、門、獨眼天使——它們合起來就是那條路。我把自己的路想起來了，清楚得像雨！黑暗，碎片，小女孩，裂縫，綠寶石項鍊，還有獨眼天使。
